name: comp-phone
prompt:
The first screen of the same landing page on a phone (375 by 667 points), rendered edge to edge, no phone hardware, no hand. A slim top bar with "Salomón Muriel" at the left and a menu button at the right. Below it one tall rounded dark frame fills the screen with a small margin: in its upper part the portrait of a bald, smiling man in a dark green wool coat with arms crossed on a near-black backdrop, his face fully visible; across the frame's lower half a solid charcoal box holds the headline "Software a la medida para tu PYME" in big off-white type on three lines, a short paragraph "Te construyo el sistema operativo de tu empresa: el software que reemplaza los Excel que no cuadran y el copiar y pegar.", then two full-width stacked buttons: moss-green "Cuéntame de tu empresa" and a pale outline "Escríbeme al 313 246 5100". Nothing else on the screen.

Style: Finished, production-quality marketing website design comp, flat UI rendering, crisp readable type, real Spanish copy. Look: warm stone-grey page grounds (#eeecea, with one band in a slightly darker stone #e4e1dd), charcoal ink (#333231) for all text, exactly one muted moss-green accent (#5c6b54) used only for the main button and tiny marks. One neo-grotesk sans family (like Red Hat Display) for everything, headlines large in regular weight with tight letter spacing, never bold. Soft 12px corners, hairline rules, no gradients, no drop shadows, no glassmorphism, no emoji, no stock icons. Quiet, confident, editorial; a one-person craftsman studio from Bogota, not a SaaS template.
cost_note: OpenAI usage x $30/M image out, $8/M image in, $5/M text in (Batch half); other providers: see extra
